name: Accessibility by Accessiy – One Click ADA, EAA & WCAG Compliance
author: CodeConfig

sections.description:
Accessiy is the #1 WordPress accessibility plugin, designed to enhance website accessibility for all users, including those with visual, auditory, motor, or cognitive disabilities. With a one-click accessibility setup, Accessiy ensures your site meets WCAG 2.1, ADA, and European Accessibility Act (EAA) accessibility standards. This lightweight accessibility solution, built without jQuery, delivers top-tier accessibility performance and integrates seamlessly with any WordPress theme. Accessiy’s accessibility toolkit empowers site owners to create an inclusive, accessibility-first digital experience.

👁️More Features | 👑Get Accessiy Pro | 📄Documentations | ⏯️Video Tutorials | 🎧Support

Why Choose Accessiy for WordPress Accessibility?

Accessiy is the ultimate accessibility plugin for WordPress, offering a no-code accessibility solution to make your site universally accessible. Key accessibility benefits include:
– One-Click Accessibility Setup: Activate accessibility features instantly for immediate accessibility improvements.
– WCAG & EAA Accessibility Compliance: Supports global accessibility standards like WCAG 2.1 and EAA for inclusive accessibility.
– Customizable Accessibility Toolbar: Tailor accessibility icon, size, position, and branding for seamless accessibility integration.
– Lightweight Accessibility Design: Optimized for speed with no jQuery, ensuring fast accessibility performance.
– Multilingual Accessibility Support: Offers accessibility in 35+ languages, including all EU accessibility-compliant languages.
– GDPR-Compliant Accessibility: No user data collection; accessibility settings stored in localStorage for privacy-focused accessibility.
– Responsive Accessibility Design: Accessibility optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
– Accessibility Statement Generator: Create a compliance-ready accessibility statement to showcase your accessibility commitment.

Why Is Accessibility Important

Accessibility is essential for ethical and legal reasons. Website owners are responsible for ensuring accessibility compliance with WCAG and EAA standards, making accessibility features critical for inclusivity. Accessibility improves user experience, boosts SEO, and widens your audience, making accessibility a smart business choice. Accessiy simplifies accessibility compliance, helping you meet rising accessibility regulations.

Core Accessibility Features

Accessiy’s accessibility toolkit provides comprehensive accessibility enhancements for WordPress sites:

Content Accessibility Adjustments
– Bigger Text (FREE): Boost accessibility with larger font sizes for improved readability.
– Line Height (FREE): Enhance accessibility by adjusting line spacing for clearer text.
– Text Alignment (FREE): Improve accessibility with left-aligned or justified text options.
– Readable Font (FREE): Switch to dyslexia-friendly fonts for accessibility-focused readability.
– Text Magnifier (PRO): Hover-to-magnify text for advanced accessibility visibility.
– Highlight Links (FREE): Emphasize links to enhance accessibility in navigation.
– Cursor Customization (FREE): Enlarge or style cursors for accessibility-friendly visibility.
– Letter Spacing (FREE): Manage letter spacing for enhance readability.
– Keyboard Navigation (FREE): Use Keyboard to navigate your website.

Orientation Accessibility Adjustments
– Page Structure (PRO): Highlight content structure for better accessibility in navigation flow.
– Screen Reader Support (PRO): Enable text-to-speech accessibility for visually impaired users.
– Reading Mask (PRO): Dim surrounding content to focus on specific accessibility-enhanced sections.
– Site Map (PRO): Display a structured accessibility view of page elements for intuitive accessibility navigation.
– Hide Images (PRO): Reduce visual clutter for accessibility by removing images.
– Pause Animations (FREE): Stop animations to improve accessibility for motion-sensitive users.
– Mute Sounds (PRO): Disable audio for distraction-free accessibility.
– Reading Line (FREE): Add a horizontal guide for accessibility-guided reading.
– Outline Focus (FREE): Highlight headings and focusable elements for accessibility clarity.
– Highlight Titles (FREE): Highlight your website titles by one click.

Color Accessibility Adjustments
– Grayscale Mode (PRO): Convert pages to black-and-white for accessibility-friendly contrast.
– Contrast Adjustment (PRO): Optimize accessibility with enhanced contrast for visual impairments.
– Invert Colors (PRO): Invert colors for accessibility-improved visibility.
– Brightness Control (FREE): Adjust brightness for accessibility-tailored viewing comfort.
– Saturation Adjustment (PRO): Modify color intensity for accessibility-optimized visuals.

Analytics

  • Enable Analytics: One-click toggle to start tracking which features users interact with most.
  • Display Analytics: View usage data based on selected timeframes (e.g., All Time, Last 30 Days).
  • Chart Type: Choose from 13 different chart types to visualize usage trends effectively.
  • Uses Features: Displays the top 7 most used features along with a full list of all accessibility tools and their usage counts.

Multilingual Accessibility Support

Accessiy ensures accessibility across 35+ languages, including:

🇩🇪 Deutsch
🇪🇸 Español
🇫🇷 Français
🇮🇹 Italiano

🇵🇹 Português

🇸🇮 Slovenščina
🇸🇰 Slovenčina

🇬🇷 Ελληνικά
🇨🇿 Čeština
🇭🇺 Magyar

and more, for global accessibility reach.

Unlock Advanced Accessibility with Accessiy Pro

Upgrade to Accessiy Pro for premium accessibility features like screen reader accessibility, reading mask accessibility tools, and advanced color accessibility adjustments to ensure full accessibility compliance.

24/7 Support

Our dedicated accessibility support team is available 24/7 for accessibility-related installation, customization, or troubleshooting. Contact us at codeconfig.dev/contact for accessibility assistance.

Accessibility Customization Options

  • Enable/disable specific accessibility features for tailored accessibility.
  • Customize accessibility toolbar icon, title, and position (desktop, tablet, mobile).
  • Adjust accessibility-focused dark mode and cursor colors.
  • Save or reset accessibility preferences for user-friendly accessibility.
  • Show/hide accessibility plugin on specific pages or templates.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the accessibility plugin to /wp-content/plugins/accessiy or install via the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the accessibility plugin from the WordPress ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Navigate to Accessiy Settings in the dashboard to configure accessibility preferences.
sections.faq:
Do I need coding skills for Accessiy’s accessibility features?

No! Accessiy offers a no-code accessibility interface with a one-click accessibility setup for all users.

Is Accessiy an accessibility-optimized lightweight plugin?

Yes! Built without jQuery, Accessiy ensures fast accessibility performance and compatibility with all WordPress themes.

Does Accessiy support WCAG and EAA accessibility compliance?

Yes, Accessiy aligns with WCAG 2.1 and EAA accessibility standards to meet global accessibility requirements.

Which languages support Accessiy’s accessibility features?

Accessiy provides accessibility in 35+ languages, including English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Swedish, and more.

What accessibility support is available?

Our 24/7 accessibility support team is ready to help at codeconfig.dev/contact.
